subject: Proposal: Graduated discount + retention credits for upcoming renewal

Subject: Proposal: Graduated discount + retention credits for upcoming renewal

Hi Sam / procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is a first-pass proposal for EdgeTech's renewal (attached: edge_renewal_proposal_v1.xlsx). Key ideas:

- Graduated discount across commit tiers (5% / 10% / 15% at band thresholds) to give predictable unit economics as you scale.
- Retention credits: one-time credits applied to next invoice if annual commit is renewed in full; credits cliff at 9 months to encourage early renewal.
- Short price-hold window: we can hold current pricing for 9 months from signature if commit is accepted.

Quick ask: can you confirm the expected committed qps/embeddings volume for FY28 so we can map the bands to your forecast? I proposed an initial commit ladder in the spreadsheet but happy to iterate.

If agreeable, I suggest a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the numbers with Ben (technical) and Marissa (finance).

Attachments: edge_renewal_proposal_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,

Sofia — thanks for sending. A couple quick clarifying points before we lock time: 

1) Price hold length: you mentioned 9 months. Our procurement team is asking for a 12-month guarantee from signature rather than 9; is that flexible?
2) Credits mechanics: can retention credits apply pro-rata against monthly invoices if we ramp slower than expected, or do they only apply as a lump sum at renewal?
3) Legal needs a short term-sheet to confirm the band thresholds and invoice schedule; can you include a one-page summary?

I looped Maya (VP Ops) and procurement on this thread for visibility. If you can push a revised one-pager + updated spreadsheet with the 12-month hold and pro-rata option, we can fast-track internal approvals.

Hi Sam — looping in finance/ops.

Thanks for the clear asks. We can accommodate a 12-month price-hold, with two adjustments to preserve economics for both sides:

- Price-hold term: 12 months from signature, provided the initial annual commit is accepted as outlined. If the commit is subsequently reduced by more than 20% within the first 90 days, the hold becomes void.
- Credits mechanics: retention credits can be applied pro-rata to monthly invoices during the first 12 months OR redeemed as a lump sum against the final invoice when you renew — whichever you prefer. We will show pro-rata application in the updated spreadsheet.
- Acceleration clause: to give you upside if you scale quickly, discounts increase by +2% for any band exceeded by more than 25% in a rolling 30-day window (applies only after month 3).

I've attached an updated one-page term summary and a revised spreadsheet mapping bands to your FY28 forecast (SOW-EdgeTech-2027.pdf, edge_renewal_proposal_v1.xlsx - updated).

Next steps: if those guardrails look fine, Sofia will send a DocuSign for the term-sheet and I can route the SOW for signature. Payment terms remain net 30 unless procurement requests otherwise.

Attachments: SOW-EdgeTech-2027.pdf (pdf), edge_renewal_proposal_v1.xlsx (xlsx - revised)

Thanks — Marissa
